user.title: HA Plus Modes
user.description: Choose a group for mutually exclusive settings, or keep this mode independent so it can coexist with others. Create groups from the dropdown. Higher priorities override conflicting device settings across groups.

settings.title: Mode settings
settings.description: Add lights, switches, or behavior values. Adding the same setting again replaces its definition. You can also finish without effects and use the mode as an automation condition.

menu_options.device: Add or replace a light or switch
menu_options.behavior: Add or replace a behavior value

device.title: Light or switch
device.description: Choose what this device should do while the mode is in control. A higher-priority mode can temporarily override it. Brightness 0 leaves brightness unspecified; use Off to turn the device off.

behavior.title: Behavior value
behavior.description: Expose a numeric value (0–100) for your existing automations, such as bedroom_brightness = 15. Connect your button automation to effective_values on a mode status sensor. This does not change a button automatically.

group.title: Create group
group.description: Give this group a name, such as Presence or Daily rhythm. You can reuse it for other modes.

error.invalid_definition: Enter a name, valid priority, and a nonempty behavior name.
error.invalid_effect: Use a light or switch. Brightness is only available for lights set to On. Mode switches cannot be managed as effects.
error.invalid_group: Enter a group name between 1 and 80 characters.
